decision.scopeOfAccept: Accepts g21-fixture-corpus.v2 as a CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED leftover-design fixture-authoring artifact under D-056 Decision 5, binding nothing. This is not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle. The accept covers that the four platform tokens are quoted verbatim from G10 occupancy v2 and are ORDERED-EQUAL to G23 occupancy v2, that the eight copies exist at mode 0444 and are byte-identical to the frozen v1 payloads, that Windows is not copied, and that the corpus's custody and negative claims are measured true. It does not qualify DR-G21, does not execute anything, does not satisfy DR-114 or DR-133, does not close leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING, and does not authorize a recording.
decision.rationale: Seventeen dispatch attacks and ten further independent attacks were run, and all twenty-seven were refuted against live bytes. The freeze conditions hold exactly: subject af24c6e7... at mode 0444 unmoved across the whole review, all eight fixture copies unmoved at 0444, frozen v1 unmoved at 861bb4e7..., and HEAD 6267614d... matching the dispatch and the subject's own head field. Digest custody is complete in two independent sweeps, 28 of 28 recordedInputs entries and 26 of 26 structural path-digest pairs, with zero mismatches, and the subject satisfies its own remeasurementClause. The central claim was verified by construction rather than inspection. I read the platform list out of live G10 occupancy v2 and out of live G23 occupancy v2 directly and compared them as ordered sequences against the subject: identical at every index in both cases, so the list is quoted and not invented. I then confirmed the necessity of that quoting by measuring live occupancy v4, which contains zero occurrences of the token platforms, making G10 occupancy v2 the correct source rather than an override. The copies were checked beyond what the dispatch requires: digest equality would be satisfied by a stale digest field, so I compared all eight copies byte-for-byte against the v1 sources and confirmed genuine byte-identity, and I derived each expected path mechanically from its quoted platform token to prove the layout cannot drift from the quoted list. Windows was tested on disk rather than on assertion, returning zero hits, and I pressed the sharpest form of that attack, that the cited delivery.v2 lists windows-x86_64-msvc under supported; it fails because the subject scopes delivery.v2 strictly to wire bytes and never invokes it as a platform authority. The corpus is scrupulous about what it does not do: leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is empty and OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING survives in seven places, matching live leftover-join.v7 which independently names the per-D-002-platform copies as remaining leftover; the occupancy v4 passProperty is reproduced verbatim including every sentence that argues against the corpus's own sufficiency; NT-6 and the remaining classes are left unauthored; and parentReview names D-145 and naming v6 as the naming parent while expressly refusing that role to leftover-join.v7, which I confirmed by finding the G21 identifier in live gate-harness-naming.v6 and the dual 0/0 CONSENT at live COORD line 6066. Four observations are recorded, the strongest being that windowsStandingQuotedFromG10OccupancyV2 truncates its source and appends the corpus's own sentence under a field name that promises a quote. I weighed that one hard, since quote-versus-invent is this document class's whole discipline and both the lineage precedent and the subject's own other quoted field are verbatim. It does not reach SHOULD-FIX: the appended sentence is transparently self-referential and unattributable to G10, the dropped sentence disposes of a delivery.v2 platform tension the subject never raises, the Windows exclusion is over-determined in six other places, the operative behaviour is verified correct on disk, and the platform list that the dispatch actually gates on is verbatim and ORDERED-EQUAL. It is a field-naming precision nit for a successor. Zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX survive verification.
